data.name: GraFi Halloween
data.detailed_description:
GraFi Halloween is a colorful 2D physics puzzle game that combines gravity manipulation, challenging traps, moving treadmills, mysterious portals, and spooky Halloween-themed artwork. Change the direction of gravity, guide a small blue coin through tricky environments, and discover clever solutions in this entertaining collection of holiday logic puzzles and brain teasers.

Enter a playful world of Halloween-inspired physics puzzles where gravity is your most powerful tool. Instead of controlling the coin directly, manipulate gravitational forces to influence its movement. Experiment with different gravity directions, observe how the coin reacts, and use physics to overcome obstacles. Every level challenges your logical thinking, concentration, spatial reasoning, and precision.

Your objective is simple but surprisingly challenging: move the blue coin onto the blue rock and keep it there long enough to complete the level. Navigate dangerous traps, deal with moving treadmills, and discover how portals affect your path. Carefully plan each gravity change, anticipate the coin's movement, and find the correct solution through experimentation and precise timing.

With 50 levels of gravity-based puzzle challenges, GraFi Halloween offers an engaging combination of classic physics puzzles, obstacle avoidance, and precision-based gameplay. Moving surfaces, portals, and tricky environmental hazards add variety to gravity puzzles, encouraging you to think creatively and discover effective ways to reach your destination.

Immerse yourself in a colorful Halloween atmosphere filled with spooky Jack-o'-lanterns, creepy spiders, and charming seasonal decorations. The minimalist 2D artwork combines playful Halloween imagery with clean puzzle environments, creating a distinctive holiday twist on the classic GraFi gameplay.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, Halloween games, challenging physics puzzles, or clever brain teasers, GraFi Halloween offers an accessible yet rewarding single-player experience. Experiment with gravity, overcome tricky obstacles, and enjoy the satisfaction of completing every level while surrounded by festive spooky aesthetics.

With its distinctive colorful 2D minimalist visuals, engaging background music, and straightforward gameplay mechanics, GraFi Halloween delivers a seasonal puzzle experience where simple controls meet challenging physics. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, casual gamers, and anyone looking for a Halloween-themed logic game that rewards careful observation, patience, and precise decisions.

Key Features

  • 50 challenging puzzle levels – Solve Halloween-themed gravity puzzles that test your logic, concentration, timing, and precision.

  • Gravity manipulation gameplay – Change the direction of gravity to control the movement of a small blue coin.

  • Halloween-themed physics puzzles – Enjoy creative gravity challenges surrounded by spooky holiday artwork and colorful seasonal aesthetics.

  • Moving treadmills and conveyor belts – Navigate moving surfaces that influence the coin's movement and introduce additional physics challenges.

  • Portals and obstacles – Encounter mysterious portals and tricky environmental hazards while discovering effective solutions.

  • Blue coin challenges – Guide the coin onto the blue rock and keep it in position long enough to complete each level.

  • Dangerous traps – Avoid hazards and carefully plan your movements to overcome challenging puzzle layouts.

  • Logic puzzles and brain teasers – Exercise your problem-solving skills, spatial reasoning, patience, and attention to detail.

  • Precision and timing challenges – Determine when to change gravity and how to position the coin accurately.

  • Spooky Halloween artwork – Enjoy colorful 2D visuals featuring carved pumpkins, creepy spiders, and festive seasonal decorations.

  • Jack-o'-lanterns and spiders – Discover playful Halloween imagery that brings a charming spooky atmosphere to the puzzle experience.

  • Minimalist abstract graphics – Explore clean, colorful puzzle environments that keep the focus on gravity-based gameplay.

  • Engaging background music – Enjoy an atmospheric soundtrack that accompanies your Halloween puzzle adventure.

  • Simple but challenging mechanics – Easy-to-understand objectives combined with physics puzzles that reward experimentation and creative thinking.

  • 100 Steam Achievements – Complete challenges and unlock achievements throughout your spooky journey.

  • Steam Cloud support – Keep your game progress synchronized across supported devices.

  • Single-player puzzle experience – Solve gravity challenges at your own pace and enjoy a colorful Halloween atmosphere.

Change gravity, overcome the traps, master the physics, and celebrate Halloween with every puzzle you solve in GraFi Halloween!
